ruleset.name: canopica
ruleset.description: Cyclomatic complexity only -- matches the manual audit's own McCabe threshold (docs/STATUS.md, 2026-08-27: "above 10," not "at 10") and ruff's C901/mccabe config on the Python side (ai/data-platform/worker pyproject.toml). Deliberately narrow: PMD's full "design" category covers many rules this project hasn't evaluated or agreed to yet, and adding all of them silently along with this one would be undisclosed scope creep, not the change this ruleset is for.
